must_run_experiments.name: m5_labels
must_run_experiments.family: Path-dependent / redefined TRAINING LABELS (triple-barrier / trend-scanning / jump-filtered-diffusive / vol-adaptive deadband)
must_run_experiments.mechanism: Distinct from loss-reweighting: every prior 5m kill reweighted or gated the SAME raw-binary 300s-sign target. This REDEFINES the target using on-disk 1s intrabar hi/lo to denoise/path-condition the sign label or isolate the diffusive (drift-recoverable) component, then evaluates on the TRUE unsmoothed 300s mid-to-mid sign. Sign-carrying; not covered by any run.
must_run_experiments.design: ONE heavy job m5_labels.py. Reuse MX.build_xp(SPL,stride=4)+MX.augment+MX.feat_cols(MODE) for the IDENTICAL certified cross-pair X (cols=primary_feats), same LGBMClassifier hyperparams as m5_xpair (lr0.02,num_leaves127,min_child400,n_est3000,early_stop150), same meta-labeler + tight primary-confidence cover (cov in {0.05,0.10,0.15}, selection on worst-VAL-half via MX boot). Build 4 alternative TRAIN-label sets on the same anchors, all using 1s ticks for the path: (1) triple-barrier: symmetric +/-k*sigma_t barriers on the 1s mid path within 300s, label=sign(first touch), k swept {0.5,1.0}; (2) trend-scanning: sign(OLS slope of mid over forward 60-300s), sample_weight=|t-stat|; (3) jump-filtered diffusive-only: Lee-Mykland/BNS bipower test on the 300s window, DROP jump-dominated bars from TRAIN, label remainder by 300s sign; (4) 3-class vol-adaptive deadband: drop |ret|<deadband_t bars, direction=sign(p_up-p_down). For EACH variant train UP and DOWN heads; EVALUATE on the TRUE unsmoothed 300s sign with deriv wc_ret (ties LOSE, breakeven 0.541), MX.nonoverlap_chrono(ts,mask,300), per-year 2024/2025/2026 boot CI95, moved-bars up-rate tripwire [0.47,0.53]. Compare UP binding-2025 vs incumbent .577 (refit floor .553) and DOWN binding-2025 vs magweight POW=0.5 DOWN cov0.05 p10 .5441.
must_run_experiments.prereg_falsifier: Write into m5_labels_result.json BEFORE OOS. KILL the whole label-engineering family if NO variant yields a UP-side binding-2025 (min per-year, TRUE-300s-sign, ties-LOSE, worst-VAL-half-selected) win-rate with CI95-lo >= 0.541 that ALSO beats incumbent .577 by >1 SE, AND no variant yields a DOWN-side binding-2025 CI95-lo >= 0.541 that beats magweight DOWN p10 .5441 by >1 SE. If the best variant's 2025 up-rate breaches [0.47,0.53] or it only wins on the SMOOTHED label (fails on TRUE unsmoothed 300s sign), record subsumed.

must_run_experiments.name: m5_leadlag_te_rff
must_run_experiments.family: Strictly-lagged / learnable cross-pair lead-lag + transfer-entropy directed-info gate + RFF virtue-of-complexity (merged anti-contemporaneous causal-sieve job)
must_run_experiments.mechanism: The certified m5xp uses CONCURRENT cross-pair returns. Three distinct never-run sign mechanisms, all anti-contemporaneous or distinct-function-form, sharing one heavy job: (a) STRICTLY-LAGGED-only learned/nonlinear lead-lag (block all contemporaneous info; does any major LEAD EURUSD next-300s sign? distinct from the LINEAR 76-signed-lag probe m5_legsign); (b) TRANSFER ENTROPY TE(1s signed-flow->next-300s return), an asymmetric nonlinear directed-information per-bar gate (distinct from CCM which tested coupling existence, and from linear signed-lags); (c) RFF virtue-of-complexity ridge (P up to 1e5) — distinct functional form from GBM-tree-nonlinearity and from the MLP info-bound in m5_deep.
must_run_experiments.design: ONE heavy job m5_leadlag_te_rff.py. PRIMARY (lead-lag): build STRICTLY-LAGGED EURUSD-equiv returns (eu_equiv_sign-adjusted) of all 6 non-EUR majors at lags {30,60,120,300s} with NO contemporaneous term, + interday same-clock-minute EURUSD lags (1-5 trading days), + within-300s late-flow-fraction; train an LGBM AND a sparse TopK learned-lag selector to predict TRUE next-300s EURUSD sign; require lagged-feature permutation importance non-zero at worst-VAL-half. SECONDARY (TE): per 5m bar compute TE(1s signed-flow -> next-300s return) over a rolling window from features_of ticks; (i) standalone sign of high-TE flow; (ii) GATE the certified m5xp UP/DOWN signal on high-TE bars. TERTIARY (RFF): RFF expansion of m5xp inputs (cross-pair USD-residual+OFI+returns), closed-form ridge, sweep P in {200,2000,12000,100000} x gamma x ridge-z; OOS dirAUC monotonicity in P + gated binding-2025. ALL evaluated deriv-faithful: wc_ret ties-LOSE breakeven 0.541, MX.nonoverlap_chrono(300), per-year 2024/2025/2026 CI95, worst-VAL-half selection, up-rate tripwire [0.47,0.53]. Compare binding-2025 UP vs .577 (floor .553) and DOWN vs magweight .5441.
must_run_experiments.prereg_falsifier: Write into m5_leadlag_te_rff_result.json BEFORE OOS. KILL each sub-mechanism independently: (lead-lag) if strictly-lagged permutation importance ~0 at worst-VAL-half OR lagged-only binding-2025 UP CI95-lo<0.541 AND DOWN CI95-lo<0.541 — to CERTIFY a NEW lead-lag edge it must beat concurrent m5xp .577 (UP) by >1 SE; merely tying => subsumed by m5_xpair.py. (TE) if high-TE-bar standalone direction binding-2025 CI95-lo<0.541 AND TE-gating does not lift m5xp UP>.577 (or DOWN>.5441) by >1 SE => subsumed (collapses to the CCM/legsign regime-dependence). (RFF) if OOS dirAUC FLAT/DECREASING in P across all (gamma,z) AND best-P gated binding-2025 UP CI95-lo<0.541 or fails to beat GBM .577 by >1 SE => subsumed by m5_deep info-bound.

must_run_experiments.name: m5_signedpayoff_torch
must_run_experiments.family: Asymmetric signed-payoff TRAINING objective: GMADL/MADL custom loss + differentiable-Sharpe/RRL tanh-signed-position head (merged torch heavy job)
must_run_experiments.mechanism: Two REFUTED-subsumption mechanisms (challenge: subsumption_holds=false, data on-disk) sharing one torch/feature heavy job, both sign-COUPLED objectives that NO on-disk script implements. (a) GMADL/MADL: L=-(1/N)sum sigmoid(a*R*Rhat)*|R|^b (a in {50,100}, b in {1,2}) as a custom LightGBM fobj AND a torch-MLP head — a sign-WRONG large move is penalized MORE than a sign-right one; does NOT reduce to symmetric |ret|^POW*BCE (magweight m5_magweight.py:36-43 is objective=binary symmetric weight) nor focal/asym (m5_lossbatch sign-agnostic reweight) nor LambdaRank (m5_rankloss, BCE-ordering-equivalent). (b) RRL/diff-Sharpe: net outputs X_t=tanh(f(features)) in [-1,1], trained by backprop through the realized deriv-payoff/Sharpe objective (ties-LOSE binary settlement, win=+0.85/loss=-1), NOT BCE; SIGN of X_t IS the decision. Every NN on disk (m5_deep.py:62,108; m5_deep_ens.py:34) uses BCEWithLogitsLoss, so m5_deep's AUC .5218 bounds only the CLASSIFICATION objective, not a realized-payoff objective.
must_run_experiments.design: ONE heavy job m5_signedpayoff_torch.py built from the m5_magweight.py + m5_deep.py skeletons on the IDENTICAL on-disk cross-pair matrix (MX.build_xp + MX.augment + MX.feat_cols(MODE), cols=primary_feats) with signed MX _fwd return. HEAD A (GMADL): custom LightGBM fobj returning grad/hess of -sigmoid(a*R*Rhat)*|R|^b wrt raw logit, plus a 2-layer CPU-torch MLP variant with the same loss; sweep a in {50,100}, b in {1,2}. HEAD B (RRL): 2-layer torch MLP, tanh signed output X_t in [-1,1], train 2012-2021 minimizing L=-mean(X_t * deriv_payoff_t) with deriv_payoff = ties-LOSE binary settlement at H=300s (win +0.85, loss -1); gate UP iff X_t>tau, DOWN iff X_t<-tau, tau on worst-VAL-half. BOTH heads: gate NY/pr-confidence cover, eval deriv wc_ret ties-LOSE breakeven 0.541, MX.nonoverlap_chrono(300) independent UP and DOWN trades, per-year 2024/2025/2026 CI95, moved-bars up-rate tripwire [0.47,0.53], selection on worst-VAL-half. Compare DOWN binding-2025 vs magweight POW=0.5 DOWN cov0.05 .5594/p10 .5441 and UP binding-2025 vs incumbent .577 (refit floor .553). If a survivor clears the forward split, run nested-refit CPCV (mirror m5_aci_cpcv.py 28 purged paths) requiring frac_clear_0.541 >= 0.80 and p10 >= incumbent BEFORE any freeze.
must_run_experiments.prereg_falsifier: Write into m5_signedpayoff_torch_result.json BEFORE OOS. KILL (loss-reoptimization + sizing-policy families empirically exhausted) unless a worst-VAL-half-selected book beats the incumbent on the BINDING 2025 year on >=1 side at matched-or-higher nonoverlap_chrono n: DOWN-2025 win-rate CI95-lo >= 0.541 AND > magweight DOWN .5594, OR UP-2025 CI95-lo > incumbent .577 by >1 SE; AND moved-bars up-rate in [0.47,0.53]; AND 2026 does NOT collapse <0.541 (the failure mode of every prior |ret|-weighted retrain); AND a survivor must additionally pass nested-refit CPCV (p10>=0.541 AND >=80% of 28 purged paths clear) — failing refit = KILL the way ACI did.

must_run_experiments.name: m5_residlabel_down_h5
must_run_experiments.family: DOWN-side rescue via risk-residual RELABELED target at H=5 (factor-residualized DOWN label, DOWN-split readout)
must_run_experiments.mechanism: REFUTED subsumption (challenge: subsumption_holds=false, data on-disk). Every cited DOWN kill (downspec/refit/magweight/pool/downcond/calib-ACI) REWEIGHTS, GATES, CALIBRATES or POOLS the RAW EURUSD-sign target. The risk-residual member RELABELS the target = sign(EURUSD_fwd5 - causal_beta_t * USD-basket_fwd5), a distinct mechanism. min1_residtarget.py:348 ran only H=15 and H=1 (H=5 NEVER executed) and reports POOLED resid-sign, never a DOWN-split. The adjacent H=15 pooled resid-sign hit 2025 0.5595 (n1210) but was never decomposed by side.
must_run_experiments.design: Run min1_residtarget.py at MX_HOR=5: add H=5 to the loop (currently line 348 ((15,6),(1,30)) -> add (5,6)), reusing the verified causal-rolling-OLS beta_t (BETA_WIN=500, zero look-ahead, anchors [t-H-win,t-H)) against the on-disk 7-major USD-basket. ADD the DOWN-SPLIT the existing script omits: separately tabulate resid-sign accuracy on bars where the residual model votes DOWN (resid_score<0.5), per-year 2024/2025/2026, deriv-faithful (MX.nonoverlap_chrono 300, ties-LOSE, breakeven 0.541, NY gate, moved-only, worst-VAL-half threshold select, up-rate tripwire [0.47,0.53], boot CI95). Compare DOWN-split binding (worst of 3 yrs, n>=150) CI95-lo against 0.541 and against incumbent EURUSD.m5xp_magw_down.v1 (magweight POW=0.5 DOWN cov0.05 p10 .5441).
must_run_experiments.prereg_falsifier: Write into the result JSON before OOS. KILL the residual-label DOWN path (DOWN-side rescue family confirmed subsumed/exhausted on-disk) unless the H=5 residual-sign DOWN-SPLIT binding-year (worst of 2024/2025/2026, n>=150) accuracy CI95-lo clears 0.541 AND strictly beats incumbent magw_down p10 .5441, with moved-bars up-rate in [0.47,0.53] AND a stable same-side DOWN edge in BOTH 2024 AND 2026 (single-2025-only or sign-flip across years = KILL, the C3/2025-inversion failure mode). If 2025 DOWN-split CI95-lo <= 0.541, the only remaining DOWN lever is paywalled funded risk-reversal data.

coverage_statement: Once the 4 must-run heavy jobs are run, the on-disk 5m EURUSD DIRECTION mechanism space is exhaustively covered on BOTH sides. The four jobs close every genuinely-distinct, sign-carrying, data-on-disk gap that the existing Tier-1 corpus had NOT decisively hit: (1) m5_labels redefines the TRAINING TARGET (triple-barrier/trend-scan/jump-filter/deadband on 1s path) -- every prior kill only reweighted/gated the raw 300s-sign target, never relabeled it; (2) m5_leadlag_te_rff tests the anti-contemporaneous causal channel (strictly-lagged learned lead-lag + transfer-entropy directed-info gate + RFF virtue-of-complexity) which the CONCURRENT m5xp GBM and the LINEAR 76-signed-lag probe (m5_legsign) and CCM (min1_ccm) do not represent; (3) m5_signedpayoff_torch tests the only two objective forms never implemented -- the asymmetric SIGN-COUPLED GMADL/MADL training loss (distinct from symmetric magweight + focal/asym + BCE-equivalent LambdaRank, all killed) and the realized-payoff RRL tanh-signed-position head (every on-disk NN is BCE, whose .5218 AUC bounds only the classification objective); (4) m5_residlabel_down_h5 runs the never-executed H=5 risk-residual RELABEL with the DOWN-split the script omits, the last distinct DOWN-target mechanism. Everything else is positively subsumed by a cited Tier-1 NULL (signed order-flow -> legsign/perside/whale/xofi/hawkes/stoikov; cross-pair structure -> pool/tarvecm/xasset/triangular + GBM-MLP info-bound; deep/graph/ICL -> deep/deep_ens/ncde/rankloss at the ~0.52 info-bound; symmetric loss-reweight -> lossbatch/rankloss/magweight; distribution-head -> lossbatch quantile_median + sign-invariance; DOWN reweight/gate/calib/pool -> downspec/refit/downcond/pool/calib; infra -> certification machinery; sizing -> aci/kelly/magdyn), is magnitude-only by the sign-invariance theorem arXiv:2512.15720 (40 levers, recorded in MAGNITUDE_FINDINGS.md, out of direction scope), or is external-blocked. After the must-run set, what remains genuinely open is ONLY external/funded data with no on-disk proxy: true multi-level (10-level) LOB depth (Kyle-lambda depth-elasticity, DeepLOB/SPDE depth-profile nets), VIX/equity-vol risk-off, funded option-implied risk-reversal (the single remaining DOWN lever if the residual relabel fails), and the intraday DE-US 2y rate-differential -- all enumerated in IDEAS_LOG.md H-TODO-1/2/3 and none acquirable from the current features/ + features_of/ + features_tick/ on-disk corpus.
